items.title: Review pebble-quota's changes since the 10-22 architecture review for simplifications that keep behaviour

checks.command:
git diff --check a1a8cc676daaae2f7a78be13fbccf5c715b42243 HEAD && python3 - <<'PY'
import ast
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

baseline = '3a963b0df7dc941ce80598082e0b6705b258718c'
report = Path('docs/reviews/2026-10-25-simplification-review.md')
text = report.read_text()
assert baseline in text
headings = re.findall(r'^#{1,6} (.+)$', text, re.M)
assert headings[-1] == 'Draft issues' and all(len(h) <= 60 for h in headings)
assert 'Findings ranked by removal and risk' in headings
first = text.split('## Do these first\n')[1].split('\n## ')[0]
assert 1 <= len(re.findall(r'^- \*\*D\d', first, re.M)) <= 3
assert len(re.findall(r'^- \*\*F\d', text, re.M)) == 1
assert len(re.findall(r'^- \*\*D\d', text.split('## Draft issues\n')[1], re.M)) == 1
assert not re.search(r'/home/|http://(?:hopeli|atom)/|\.ts\.net', text)
links = dict(re.findall(r'^\[([^\]]+)\]: (\S+)$', text, re.M))
for label, url in links.items():
    target, _, anchor = url.partition('#')
    path = report.parent / target
    assert path.is_file(), (label, target)
    if anchor:
        titles = re.findall(r'^#{1,6} (.+)$', path.read_text(), re.M)
        slugs = [re.sub(r'[^\w\s-]', '', h).lower().replace(' ', '-') for h in titles]
        assert anchor in slugs, (target, anchor)
for label, ref in re.findall(r'\[([^\]\n]+)\]\[([^\]]+)\]', text):
    assert ref in links, ref
    if ':' not in label:
        continue
    source, ranges = label.split(':', 1)
    body = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{baseline}:{source}'], text=True)
    assert body == Path(source).read_text(), source
    for start, end in re.findall(r'(\d+)(?:–(\d+))?', ranges):
        assert 1 <= int(start) <= int(end or start) <= len(body.splitlines()), label
module = ast.parse(Path('tests/test_pebble_quota.py').read_text())
methods = {f'{c.name}.{f.name}' for c in module.body if isinstance(c, ast.ClassDef)
           for f in c.body if isinstance(f, ast.FunctionDef)}
for name in re.findall(r'`([A-Za-z]+Tests\.test_\w+)`', text):
    assert name in methods, name
for name in re.findall(r'`(test_\w+)`', text):
    assert any(m.endswith('.' + name) for m in methods), name
calls = [n for n in ast.walk(module) if isinstance(n, ast.Call)
         and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr == 'view']
assert calls and all(not n.args and not n.keywords for n in calls)
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--exit-code', baseline, 'HEAD', '--', '.', ':!docs', ':!TASKS.md'], check=True)
print(f'Report checks passed: baseline, structure, {len(links)} links, citation ranges, named tests, {len(calls)} argument-free view calls, unchanged application and tests.')
PY
command -v node >/dev/null && command -v cc >/dev/null && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
